reference.title: Scenario 9 — Image Linked via External URL Rather than a Local Package Reference
reference.shortdesc: Consider an HTML document where the author has referenced an image using an absolute external

section.p: Consider an HTML document where the author has referenced an image using an absolute external URL (for example, hosted on a separate website or CDN) instead of a relative path to a file included in the HTML package. Because the image file is not part of the submitted package, the converter cannot extract it.

entry.codeblock: <!-- Output A: broken reference --> <image href="media/MISSING_image.png"/> <!-- Output B: image silently dropped -->

section.p: Result: Externally hosted images produce either a broken <image> reference or are silently dropped, since the converter only extracts image files that are physically included in the submitted HTML/ZIP package. Always include image files locally within the package and reference them with a relative src path before submission.
